question: According to the 2024 World Happiness Report, which country was ranked as the happiest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Finland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Finland** has been ranked as the happiest country in the world for six consecutive years, according to the **2024 World Happiness Report**.
 
• The ranking is based on factors such as **social support, income, health, freedom, generosity, and absence of corruption**.
 
• Finland's high levels of trust in government and institutions, coupled with strong social cohesion, contribute significantly to its happiness ranking.
 
• Finnish citizens enjoy excellent healthcare, education, and work-life balance, which foster overall well-being.
 
• The country's emphasis on environmental sustainability and natural beauty also plays a vital role in enhancing the quality of life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Happiness Report**

 
 
• The World Happiness Report is an annual publication by the **United Nations Sustainable Development Solutions Network.**
 
• It uses survey data from the Gallup World Poll to assess happiness levels in various countries.
 
• The report evaluates factors such as GDP per capita, social support, life expectancy, freedom, generosity, and perceptions of corruption.
 
• It aims to provide insights into well-being and guide policymakers in fostering happiness and sustainable development.
